status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 and rc.2 are unchanged and still downloadable; this is a separate immutable archive. Since rc.2: a cause is called reproduced only when each record's own recorded values — cusps, angles and body positions, not the cusps alone — reproduce from its own declared inputs. A bounded AI review found the cusps-only check defeated by whole-sign quantisation, which let a record with a rewritten instant or place reach the strongest verdict. A differing build claim no longer refuses the replay: it is recorded as a limit, because build metadata is not a different engine and a record claiming nothing has not claimed something different. A pair that lost one house table is no longer told the house system is not the difference when the two also requested different systems, and a record with no place at all now has its missing angles and cusps accounted for rather than left unresolved.
